ai_assessment.method: Full direct source-to-Vietnamese comparison of every canonical paragraph and both titles, with semantic, voice, naturalness, image and mechanics assessment; concrete findings were revised before these final byte hashes were recorded. Another task using the same AI system also read every pair and supplied specific corrections.
ai_assessment.limitations: The same AI system drafted, revised and assessed the work; correlated same-model peer feedback is not independent review or model diversity. Earlier Pardo scores were visible. No human literary reviewer, native-reader trial or measured reader demand is claimed. Scores are subjective and uncalibrated; missed errors may remain. Source clearance is separately recorded and is not granted by this review.

findings.explanation: French window is rendered as a large glazed opening extending to floor level, preserving the passage into the garden that the final entrance requires; it is not treated as an ordinary raised window.
Changed tối hẳn to đến lúc trời đã nhá nhem for quite dusk. The source denotes twilight, not complete darkness; repeated evening waiting and the later deepening dusk remain coherent.
Replaced the English-shaped một mẩu chú ý with chút chú ý, retaining the hostess’s limited attention without an unnatural Vietnamese noun pairing.
Changed phải nằm suốt đêm to phải qua đêm: the source says that the man spent the night in a grave and does not specify that he lay down.

Vietnamese chị/em and cô/cháu supply a fluent address register where English leaves the sister’s age and aunt’s exact genealogical side unspecified. These choices are not asserted as additional facts about the characters.

Bịa chuyện keeps the fabrication and compact final reveal, but is more explicit than the genteel period sense of romance. The short, dry concluding sentence preserves the joke while some lexical ambiguity is necessarily reduced.

summary: Full assessment of all 29 English/Vietnamese paragraphs and the translated title after complete source extraction. The caller’s uncertainty, sister’s introduction letters, niece’s information gathering, invented tragedy, returning hunters, spaniel, repeated Bertie refrain, medical monologue, abrupt flight and newly improvised dog story remain in order. The original’s contrast between polite talk and predatory storytelling survives without an explanatory spoiler. Final corrections restore twilight, remove an invented posture and smooth one calque. Fidelity, naturalness, imagery and mechanics are 9.0; voice is 8.5 because period understatement and the final romance/bịa chuyện choice are not perfectly equivalent. Weighted score 8.875 satisfies the unchanged 8.6 threshold; the displayed 8.88 is not used to qualify an otherwise failing score. No unresolved major or critical issue was identified. Same-system AI drafting, revision and correlated AI feedback are disclosed; no human approval, blind assessment or model diversity is claimed.

title_review.rationale: Cửa sổ để ngỏ is a natural Vietnamese title for the window deliberately left open in the central story. It retains the concrete object and open state without announcing deception or ghosts. The prose specifies the tall glazed opening reaching the floor, so characters can walk through it without an invented climb.
